notes.title: Game is OUT NOW!!!
notes.notes: The game has just been released. We wish you a lot of fun with the girls.

notes.title: The game will be released tomorrow - October 8, 2021 at 14:00 UTC.
notes.notes: It's only exactly 24 hours now. Tomorrow at 14:00 UTC on October 08 the game will be released. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Friday 8 October 2021 at 14:00 UTC the game will be released on Steam.
notes.notes:
Finally, after many months of development, we can announce that we are ready to release SEX SUMMER SEDUCTION VR. On Friday, 8 October 2021 at 14:00 UTC the game will be released on Steam.
A lot of changes have happened. In our opinion, we made a very good and interesting game. More screenshots coming soon. I invite you to watch the new trailer and write your opinion about it. Thank you for waiting for SEX Summer seduction VR.
Once again, we would like to remind you Friday, 08 October 2021 at 14:00 UTC, the game will be released. ːsteamhappyː
